title: Compressor Restart Delay
source_reference: 经验改编：压缩机停机后的防频繁启动
requirements: Implement compressor control with a fixed 5 second restart delay. demand starts compressorRun immediately when no trip has occurred since power-up. trip stops the compressor and latches tripLatched. reset clears tripLatched only when trip is FALSE, but a new start is allowed only after 5 seconds have elapsed since trip became TRUE. Count every FALSE-to-TRUE transition of compressorRun in startCount.

creation_process: 从制冷与气源设备常见防短周期需求提炼固定延时控制
human_modifications: 固定延时为 5 秒，并明确首次启动不等待、复位不绕过延时
review_process: 检查定时起点、复位条件和启动计数边沿
确认题目可用 TON 和边沿状态实现

plc_rationale: 压缩机停机后延迟重启可减小机械和电气冲击，PLC 定时器与启动计数均为常见功能。
